bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
python3 - <<'PY'

body="2026-11-22 /start full source/runtime inventory: "+json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(",",":"))
r=subprocess.run(["gh","api","repos/seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot/issues/68/comments","-f","body="+body],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=50)
